source_findings.finding: Codex CLI is a terminal-based coding agent; phase runners should keep CLI interactions scriptable and resumable rather than UI-dependent.
source_findings.application: Continue using direct CLI bridge launches for Arby and Aster Vale with temp-only raw output and status receipts.

source_findings.finding: CLI authentication and generated secrets are separate from ChatGPT session state; update and sign-in surfaces should not be mixed with raw receipt publication.
source_findings.application: Keep secrets, session material, and raw logs out of phase artifacts.

source_findings.finding: Current Codex release flow continues to expose CLI/app-server/remote-control and plugin-related surfaces that benefit from machine-readable status receipts.
source_findings.application: Keep launch, app gate, CLI quality, marker, exposure, classifier, and phase-advance receipts separated.

source_findings.finding: MCP security guidance emphasizes scope minimization and careful handling of local tool surfaces.
source_findings.application: Keep connector and tool use read-scoped unless an exact mutation approval exists.

source_findings.finding: Secret handling should prevent repository exposure and avoid logging or alerting patterns that reveal sensitive material.
source_findings.application: Continue staged-name guards, exposure guards, redaction guards, and temp-only raw output.

x2_build_implications: Make direct CLI bridge and app-server watcher evidence reusable across v7-v8.
Treat marker-review warnings as a required safety gate, not as automatic failure or automatic pass.
Split source-ledger evidence from raw sibling outputs.
Use status-only build queues for x2 implementation work.
